_comment: SAI Test Spec Registry. Defines all valid spec names, units, result_type and comparison direction. result_type drives which report table a metric lands in: 'performance' (throughput rps / latency, dedicated table), 'scale' (capacity max counts), 'fill_rate' (route/table fill percentage), 'capability' (functional support 1/0). direction: higher_better / lower_better / equal. unit is authoritative and injected into results; callers must not hand-write units.

acl_counter_read.description: ACL counter read latency per counter

ecmp_group.description: Max ECMP next hop groups supported

ecmp_group_scale.description: ECMP next hop group create/remove throughput

ecmp_member.description: Max ECMP next hop group members supported

ecmp_member_op_latency.description: Single ECMP member add/remove latency (avg, per op)

ecmp_member_scale.description: ECMP next hop group member create/remove throughput

fdb_fill_rate.description: FDB table learn fill rate under burst test

ipv4_ipv6_route_fill_rate.description: Mixed route table fill rate under load-factor test

ipv4_ipv6_route_scale.description: Mixed IPv4/IPv6 route remove throughput (mixed-family tests are load-factor only; create is measured as fill_rate, set is not exercised cross-family)

ipv4_nexthop.description: Max IPv4 next hop entries supported

ipv4_route_fill_rate.description: IPv4 route table fill rate under load-factor test

ipv6_nexthop.description: Max IPv6 next hop entries supported

ipv6_route_fill_rate.description: IPv6 route table fill rate under load-factor test

nexthop_route_scale.description: Incidental route throughput from the nexthop scale tests (not reported; route perf is owned by the route scale tests)

pg_counter_read.description: Priority group counter read latency per PG

pg_watermark_counter_read.description: PG watermark counter read/clear latency per PG

policer_counter_read.description: Policer counter read latency per policer

port_counter_read.description: Port counter read latency per port

queue_counter_read.description: Queue counter read latency per queue

queue_watermark_counter_read.description: Queue watermark counter read/clear latency per queue

route_flap.description: ECMP route flap group/member rebuild throughput

vrf_route_scale.description: Incidental route throughput from the VRF scale test (not reported; route perf is owned by the route scale tests)
